name: Custom Entity Pager
description: Provides a Twig function that renders a lightweight previous/next pager between published nodes of a given content type, ordered by node id, created time, or a chosen field.
project_description: The Custom Entity Pager module provides a custom Twig function that creates a previous/next pager for nodes. The main goal of this module is performance, not complexity: instead of relying on Views it runs a single direct query against node_field_data and derives the neighbouring nodes in PHP. It has no configuration UI or blocks and is meant for developers who call the Twig function from a theme template. It depends only on Drupal core (node module). Similar modules include Entity Pager (which relies on Views), Flippy and Previous/Next API (which render the pager via a block).
